The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph (approx. 13.9 m/s) while the lead vehicle is traveling at 4.6 m/s (approx. 16.6 kph) and is located 28 meters ahead. The significant speed differential (approx. 9.3 m/s) indicates a high risk of collision if the ego vehicle maintains its current speed. Therefore, the ego vehicle must decelerate to match the lead vehicle's speed or maintain a safe following distance. Action A1 typically represents deceleration or braking in this context.
